description: B2B Prospecting module UI: CA Firms list, B2B Leads list, Contacts, the CA Firm 360-degree profile page, and the full nested B2B sidebar section. This turns the FEAT-002 schema into usable screens using the existing design system (Card/Table/Tabs/Badge/Select/Dialog) and the leads module as the pattern. Firms are first-class accounts; a firm has many contacts; leads/prospects reference a firm.
steps: Expand the B2B sidebar section in src/components/app-shell.tsx to the full structure from spec section 2, gated to roles ['admin','b2b'] (admin sees all via visibleFor). Group under a B2B heading: Dashboard, Prospecting (B2B Leads, CA Firms, Contacts, Import Leads), Activities (My Tasks, Follow-ups, Calls, Meetings, Activity History), Partnerships (Pipeline, Active Partners, Referrals, Partner Performance), Analytics (B2B Performance, Source Analytics, Employee Performance, Revenue Analytics), Renewals, Documentation, Attendance, Payroll. Follow the existing NAV item shape; only add links to routes that exist after each phase, but you MAY create the section now and point not-yet-built items at a 'coming soon' placeholder OR add them incrementally — prefer adding the Prospecting group fully here and the rest in their phases. Keep MobileTabBar working (it derives from the same arrays).

Create route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/firms/index.tsx — CA Firms list. Columns: Firm Name, Partner Status (badge), City/State, Owner (assigned_to -> profile full_name), Primary Contact, Total Referrals, Total Revenue, Last Contact, Next Follow-up. Use the existing Table primitive, filters (search box, status select, assigned-to select, city/state) modeled on leads/index.tsx. Row click navigates to the firm 360 page. Add a 'New CA Firm' dialog (reuse Dialog + form patterns). RLS already scopes rows; admin sees all. guardRoles(['admin','b2b']).

Create route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/firms/$id.tsx — the CA Firm 360-degree profile (spec sections 5 & 6). Layout with Tabs or sections: Firm Information header (name, partner status, owner, location, partner since, primary contact); Performance strip (Total Referrals, Total Bookings, Total Revenue, Last Referral, Last Booking, Last Contact) via b2b-queries getFirm360; Contacts tab (list + add/edit contact dialog, mark primary); Activity Timeline tab (chronological b2b_activities: calls/whatsapp/emails/meetings/notes/followups with icons, plus a 'log activity' action); Partnerships/Opportunities tab (open partnerships for this firm); Referrals tab (referrals from this firm with convert/link status); Documents + Notes section; Next action / follow-up panel with inline update. Reuse clients/client-detail-dialog.tsx and leads/$id.tsx as patterns for timeline + logging.

Create route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/leads/index.tsx — B2B Leads/Prospects list with the fields from spec section 4 and the full B2B_LEAD_STATUSES as the status filter/badges (from src/lib/b2b.ts). Include search, status filter, assigned-to filter, source filter, priority, next-follow-up sort. 'New B2B Lead' dialog. Each row links to the firm (or a lead detail). Model closely on src/routes/_authenticated/leads/index.tsx including mobile card fallback for responsiveness.
Create route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/contacts/index.tsx — Contacts list across firms (name, designation, firm, phone, email), searchable, each links to its firm 360. Reuse Table.

Wire activity logging: when a user logs a call/whatsapp/email/meeting/note from the firm 360 or a lead, insert a b2b_activities row via b2b-queries.createActivity and refresh the timeline (TanStack Query invalidation). Also call logAudit for create/edit/status/assignment on firms and leads (extend AuditEntity in src/lib/audit.ts to include 'ca_firm' | 'b2b_lead' | 'referral').
Ensure every new route uses guardRoles(queryClient, ['admin','b2b']) in beforeLoad. Rebuild to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts and commit it. Prettier new files; no new eslint errors on touched files.
Responsiveness: tables must degrade to cards or horizontal scroll on mobile like leads/index.tsx; verify classes, since the sandbox cannot run a dev server.
acceptance_criteria: CA Firms list, B2B Leads list, and Contacts list render with existing design-system components, filters, and role-guarded routes; data reads through b2bDb()/b2b-queries with RLS scoping.

A CA Firm has a working 360 profile page showing firm info, performance totals, contacts (add/edit, mark primary), chronological activity timeline, partnerships, referrals, documents/notes, and an inline next-follow-up update.
Multiple contacts can belong to one firm and are shown under that firm.
B2B sidebar Prospecting group is present and visible only to admin + b2b users; existing nav unaffected.
logAudit is invoked for B2B create/edit/status/assignment; AuditEntity extended.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds and regenerates routeTree.gen.ts.
verification: Confirm new /b2b/firms, /b2b/firms/$id, /b2b/leads, /b2b/contacts routes are registered in routeTree.gen.ts and all use guardRoles(['admin','b2b']).
findings: Gate green: npx tsc --noEmit clean; bun run test = 153 passed / 12 files (unchanged — no new unit tests, this is pure UI); bun run build ok (~12s) and regenerated src/routeTree.gen.ts with all four new routes (/b2b/leads/, /b2b/firms/, /b2b/contacts/, /b2b/firms/$id). Delivered: (1) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/firms/index.tsx — CA Firms list: Table (desktop) + card fallback (md:hidden), search/partner-status/owner/city-state filters, inline NewFirmDialog (not exported), row click -> firm 360, logAudit('ca_firm','create'). (2) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/firms/$id.tsx — THIN route (only Route + a 2-line wrapper) that renders <Firm360Page id> from src/components/b2b/firm-360.tsx; the heavy 360 body (header, 8-tile performance strip, Timeline/Contacts/Partnerships/Referrals/Notes tabs, LogActivityDialog, ContactDialog, setPrimaryContact) lives in the component file per the perf rule (never export a heavy component from a route file). (3) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/leads/index.tsx — B2B Leads list: full B2B_LEAD_STATUSES badges+filter, search/assigned/source/priority filters + next-follow-up sort, inline NewB2BLeadDialog, logAudit('b2b_lead','create'); rows link to firm 360 when firm_id set. (4) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/contacts/index.tsx — contacts across firms via new listAllContacts() join, searchable, link to firm 360. ALL four routes use guardRoles(context.queryClient, ['admin','b2b']) in beforeLoad. (5) src/lib/b2b-queries.ts extended (additive): createFirm/updateFirm (NewFirm/FirmPatch), listAllContacts (ContactWithFirm via `*, ca_firms(firm_name)` embed), createContact/updateContact/setPrimaryContact, createB2BLead/updateB2BLead, listAssignableUsers (reads public.profiles through b2bDb), and B2BLeadFilters gained source/priority/sortByFollowUp. (6) src/lib/audit.ts AuditEntity extended to add 'ca_firm' | 'b2b_lead' | 'referral'. (7) src/components/app-shell.tsx: added 3 flat NAV entries (B2B Leads, CA Firms, Contacts) right after the existing B2B Dashboard entry, all gated roles:['admin','b2b']; MobileTabBar derives from the same NAV array so it keeps working. GOTCHAS for later phases: (a) The nav is a FLAT array (no grouping/heading support in app-shell) — the spec's nested 'Prospecting / Activities / Partnerships / Analytics' groups are expressed as flat items; later phases should append their items the same way (Import Leads is FEAT-004, Pipeline/Referrals/Analytics/etc. later). Keep per-file edits surgical: do NOT run prettier --write on app-shell.tsx (it carries 13 pre-existing prettier errors; confirmed still exactly 13 after my 5-line add, i.e. no NEW errors). (b) routeTree.gen.ts IS git-tracked (grep_search hides it as ignored but it shows as modified in git status) — it was committed. (c) setPrimaryContact does 3 sequential writes (clear is_primary on firm's contacts, set on one, point ca_firms.primary_contact_id) rather than a transaction — no RPC exists and RLS scopes the rows, so this is safe. (d) Owner/assigned-to selectors read public.profiles via b2bDb().from('profiles') (profiles IS in generated types but reusing the b2b escape hatch keeps all B2B data access in one place). (e) New-firm/new-lead dialogs default assigned_to+owner to the current user so RLS INSERT WITH CHECK (created_by = auth.uid()) and owner-scoped SELECT let the creator immediately see the row. (f) Firm 360 reuses the FEAT-002 getFirm360() aggregate; its totals.revenue sums referrals.revenue. (g) All new .tsx are prettier-clean (ran prettier --write on the 6 new/edited files).
